senses.gloss:
टङ्क् टङ्क्, i. 1(?), and 10, Par.
 1. † To bind.
 2. To cover (ved.).
 --With the prep. वि वि, वितङ्कित,
 1. Marked, Bhāg. P. 1, 16, 36.
 2. Loaded, Bhāg. P. 4, 4, 5.

टङ्क टङ्क,
 I. m. and n.
 1. A hatchet, Hariv. 5009.
 2. Slope, Bhaṭṭ. 1, 8 (Sch.).
 II. m.
 1. A weight equal to 4 māṣas, Lass. 29, 4.
 2. (and n?) A coin, Hit. 98, 11.
टङ्कवन्त् टङ्क + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Sloping, Rām. 3, 55, 44.
